stage: Natural evidence-dependence falsification, zero new training
scope: Exploratory continuation after observing prior full-validation pooling results; not a prospectively independent confirmatory trial
unit: All conditions applied to the same emitted track; repeated observations and sampling seeds are not independent replicates

pair_diagnostic.primary_feature: L2-normalized raw track-head appearance before tracker fusion; shared backbone/training and selection, not independent noise
pair_diagnostic.secondary_feature: normalized cls_feats, explicitly shares category pathway
pair_diagnostic.score_control: within-track rank of all observations, bins fixed before new error-pair outcomes
pair_diagnostic.lag: exact lag primary; prespecified [1-2,3-5,6-10,11+] support sensitivity
pair_diagnostic.scoring: Existing class-agnostic Hungarian GT matches only for separate scoring, with single/mixed identity and per-class support
pair_diagnostic.limits: Natural correlation alone neither identifies a causal dependence failure nor proves an implementable benefit

readouts.kernel: ((1+cos(normalized raw track-head appearance))/2)^4, one fixed scale
readouts.deduplication: Collapse exact identical feature and posterior evidence; score, box and time excluded from exact signature
readouts.weight: inverse kernel density, nonnegative normalized over unique evidence rows

checks: Synthetic single-frame/exact-duplication limits and small real-video readout parity
Full source/key/observation inventory and GT isolation
Natural same-error dependence under time/score/identity controls
Equal-budget random/score/FPS controls; full pooling and reliability weighting
Per-class and pure/mixed support, mask-specific residual benefits
Official TETA for main controls and exact frozen-geometry replay with independent count parity if used

primary_comparisons: released dependence minus released full sumlog
corrected dependence minus corrected full sumlog
adoption: No new training based solely on a named kernel, attention weight or video-bootstrap interval; benefit beyond controls, mechanism support and distinct novelty are still required
protected: Existing training, upstream repository, released baseline, old audit artifacts remain unchanged
source_clarification: Confirmed active OVTrackRoIHeadUncertainty ROI track-head output and non-inplace tracker fusion; source description corrected without changing numerical feature arrays or analysis settings
